title: Host Terms Schedule C: Cancellation Policies a Listing May Offer
content:
# Schedule C — Cancellation Policies a Listing May Offer

*Schedule to the Roamhaven host terms for Roamhaven Listings.*

The cancellation policy a listing offers to new bookings is chosen from the menu of its space type.

| Space type | Cancellation policies on the menu | Host account tiers allowed to choose a Super Strict policy | Stays a change of cancellation policy affects |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shared Room | Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict | Professional Host Plus, Enterprise Partner | stays booked after the change is saved |
| Private Room | Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict | Professional Host Plus, Enterprise Partner | stays booked after the change is saved |
| Entire Guest Suite | Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict | Professional Host Plus, Enterprise Partner | stays booked after the change is saved |
| Entire Apartment | Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days | Professional Host Plus, Enterprise Partner | stays booked after the change is saved |
| Entire Home | Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days | Professional Host Plus, Enterprise Partner | stays booked after the change is saved |
| Luxury Villa | Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days | Professional Host Plus, Enterprise Partner | stays booked after the change is saved |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The Super Strict policies (Super Strict 30 Days and Super Strict 60 Days) appear only on the Entire Apartment, Entire Home and Luxury Villa menus.
2. The Luxury Villa menu does not carry Flexible, Moderate or Limited.
3. For every space type, the host account tiers allowed to choose a Super Strict policy are Professional Host Plus and Enterprise Partner.

## Reading examples (hypothetical listings)

- A Private Room listing cannot offer Super Strict 30 Days, because that policy is not on the Private Room menu.
- A Luxury Villa listing may offer Firm but not Moderate.
